description: Baby, just say yes! Teach your Python programs the love language of the JVM with Py4J - a high-performance tool to leverage the power of the JVM from within Python itself for performance, fun and profit. Learn how to use Py4j, the core package behind big data engines like PySpark, to unlock the magic of powerful performance driven applications with clean and easy to use Python APIs.
title: Python and the JVM - A Love Story
